summary: Small pool-side car park in Musgrave Park; busy, overlooked, likely staff or patron use.

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto trees and pool; nearest dwellings 58 m or more, but park, pool and busy road all in view.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars sit in the car park; access looks like a narrow paved path from the road, so van entry is uncertain.
drivers.traffic: Busy arterial 40 m west with kerb parking; pool users and park walkers pass nearby.
drivers.convention: No campervans seen; looks like pool staff or patron parking.

flags: Noise from busy road and pool
Mapped gate 17 m away, not on only access
Pin is approximate; place judged is pool car park
sun_shade: Shaded by large trees, mostly from the north and east; open to the afternoon sun from the south-west.
cannot_judge: Whether the car park is signed or gated for pool users only
Whether a van can fit the path entrance

best_section.where: Small car park at the north-west end of Musgrave pool, reached by the paved path off Edmondstone St
